title: Extract a shared FirestoreGateway/AuthRepository test fake instead of duplicating ~200-line stub classes per file
rule: Fowler-duplication (shotgun surgery); TQ-4 spirit; drives AG-3
why: tutored_mirror_wipe_test.dart hand-rolls the ~46-method FirestoreGateway interface TWICE: diffing _RevokedGateway (118-332) against _ErrorGateway (651-858) shows only the two thrown-exception lines differ, everything else is byte-identical boilerplate. sync_rework_orchestrator_test.dart and sync_rework_profile_programs_pull_test.dart each re-implement the same ~46 no-op methods again from scratch. _StubAuthRepository (28 throw-UnimplementedError overrides) is copy-pasted verbatim across two files even though test/mocks/mock_repositories.dart already ships `class MockAuthRepository extends Mock implements AuthRepository {}` for exactly this purpose, and one file in this same batch (sync_orchestrator_profile0_status_test.dart's `_Gw extends Fake implements FirestoreGateway {}`) already shows the one-line alternative. Every time FirestoreGateway gains a method (evidenced by repeated 'W7.15: pushStageDefinition added', 'W6.13: fetchAuditLogEntries added', 'T1.gateway — parent-scoped child reads' comments scattered across these same files) every one of these fakes needs a matching edit or the build breaks, and this duplication is the direct cause of 3 of this batch's 8 AG-3 line-count violations.
recommendation: Add one `class NoOpFirestoreGateway extends Fake implements FirestoreGateway {}` to test/helpers (mirroring _Gw in sync_orchestrator_profile0_status_test.dart) and have each test override only the 1-3 methods it actually drives; replace both _StubAuthRepository copies with the existing MockAuthRepository plus a `when(() => mock.currentUser).thenReturn(...)` stub.
acceptance_criteria: test/helpers/ contains a Fake-based no-op FirestoreGateway reused by test/sync files instead of per-file full implementations
tutored_mirror_wipe_test.dart's _RevokedGateway and _ErrorGateway collapse to one shared base plus two small overrides
_StubAuthRepository is removed from sync_rework_curriculum_completion_doc_id_test.dart and sync_rework_push_test.dart in favor of MockAuthRepository

corrections: The '3 of 8 AG-3 violations' batch-wide count is unverifiable from my chunk alone (other batch findings not in scope), but doesn't undermine the core, independently-confirmed duplication+AG-3 claim.
